A few notes

How RSVPing works

One form per household

If you and your partner are coming together, fill out a single form and list both names. If you’re bringing a plus-one, please give us their name (we’d like to print it on a place card and not call them “Guest”).

The deadline is real

The venue needs final headcount on August 8. We’ve given ourselves a one-week buffer for following up with stragglers, so the form closes August 1. If you’re a yes, please tell us. If you’re a no, please tell us that too.

Plus-ones

Plus-ones are listed on the invitation. If your envelope has a name on it, that person is invited. If you’d like to bring someone we didn’t list, just text Maya or Devon — we’ll figure it out. We promise we won’t be weird about it.

Need to change your RSVP?

Life happens. Email hello@mayaanddevon.party with any changes up until September 10. After that, it gets hard to make adjustments — but tell us anyway, we’d rather know.
